text: Omani Fort Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Omani Fort Type: Monument - Fort Province: Balochistan District: Gwadar Period: Historic Relative Chronology: 18th Century CE Description: It is located in Gwadar city. The fort is rectangular in plan with huge walls having windows. It was built during Omani rule. In the middle of the 18th century, Mir Noori Naseer Khan Baloch captured Gwadar and its surrounding areas after defeating the Gichki Baloch tribe and included it in the Kalat Khanate.
